tr.title: Şekerhan

en.title: Şekerhan
en.description: Şekerhan is a four-storey masonry han at the head of Hoca Kasım Köprüsü Street, within the commercial fabric of Eminönü. The registered building has an enclosed area of about 2,639 square metres.
